source: fls_ridge_v1 2026Q1 out-of-sample validation dispersion from artifact training_metadata; Ridge alpha=10 selected on validation official delta-R2
rationale: Conservative affine rescaling around 0.50. The 0.15 target output standard deviation is materially wider than the raw 0.0437887 validation dispersion but remains well below the 0.288675 standard deviation of a uniform percentile target. Affine scaling preserves Pearson and Spearman before clipping and avoids the more aggressive 0.01-0.99 empirical-CDF stretch.
